blocks.content: Greetings from Run Girl Run Studio!

This is an online portfolio that documents all the work we have done.
Now, I will admit is't still a little sparse with content.

We are currently in the process of formatting all the different projects we have done, gathering the necessary media assets and creating the writeup for them.
But this process takes a while to do.

blocks.title: As such we will be doing them in stages.

steps.title: Creative Writing
steps.content: Create a rough draft of the write up, giving as much information as possible.

steps.title: Asset Finding
steps.content: Collecting all of the necessary assets

steps.title: Asset Building + Formatting
steps.content: In order to serve the content as lightweight as possible, we have to format everything to be web ready so that can load ast fast as possible for a huge majority of the audience.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.content: After grabbing all of the assets, while working on the rough copy in tandem, a project is now ready to be published on the site

blocks.content: Seeing as there are a lot of steps required to deliver all of this, there will be a huge backlog to go through.
Which means there will be plenty to look forward to!!!
